app_info.subtitle: Pakistani Legal Assistant
app_info.description: AL WAKEELO is your digital legal assistant that searches 600,000+ Pakistani case laws and statutes, drafts court petitions and commercial contracts, manages case files, tracks hearing diaries, and enables 1-click token-saving document uploads.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queries the database for matching Pakistani court judgments. Does not create or update state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Query is processed internally and results are served from local database indexes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not perform any deletions, database edits, or mutations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queries the database for matching statutory provisions and sections. Does not modify state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches only localized indexes of statutory files stored inside database.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, modify, or overwrite any statute documents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the full-text detail and headnotes of a specific judgment. No modifications to data.
justifications.open_world_justification: The document is loaded directly from local server records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or alter the requested judgment data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves knowledge files and formats summaries for analysis across RAG context. Does not modify state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches grounded details from internal indexes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute state transitions or destructive operations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates court petition drafts in text form based on grounded legal precedents without deleting or modifying existing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Runs legal drafting AI inference and uses local vectors to formulate legal drafts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not perform any destructive operations or delete user records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates agreement draft text for user convenience based on statutory contract templates.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes inputs using Contract Act 1872 legal templates.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete existing contracts or database registries.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves list of case files belonging to the authenticated lawyer. Read-only operation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the internal case management database.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or alter any case records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches comprehensive details, clients, notes, and compliance items for a specific case file.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete any case details.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new case file record in the lawyer's case management workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores case file data in the application's PostgreSQL database.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs an insert operation; does not overwrite or delete existing records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends a new progress note or hearing remark to an existing case file.
justifications.open_world_justification: Saves note content directly to the case file notes repository.
justifications.destructive_justification: Appends new note records without mutating or deleting prior notes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches scheduled court hearings and diary tasks for a specific date range.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries lawyer's court diary entries from internal database.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only query that does not modify diary state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Schedules a new court hearing date or compliance deadline in the lawyer's diary.
justifications.open_world_justification: Inserts hearing records into the court diary calendar.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new calendar entry without deleting existing hearings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates the completion status and outcome of a court hearing and optionally schedules an adjourned date.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates specific diary entry status and creates follow-up entry if adjourned.
justifications.destructive_justification: Updates hearing outcome fields without deleting hearing history.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates a secure, temporary, single-use upload session link for client-side direct file uploads.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a cryptographically signed upload session token on the server.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates temporary upload metadata; does not delete or overwrite files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Saves small base64 file payloads or notes as document attachments linked to a case file.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores document records in database and uploads payload to storage.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new document records without deleting existing case files.

test_cases.description: Search Supreme Court bail precedents under Section 497 CrPC.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find Supreme Court cases related to bail under Section 497 CrPC for murder charges.

test_cases.description: Search Pakistan Penal Code provisions for statutory ingredients.
test_cases.user_prompt: What are the punishment and statutory ingredients of criminal breach of trust under PPC 406?

test_cases.description: Draft a Constitutional Writ Petition before Lahore High Court.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a Constitutional Petition under Article 199 before Lahore High Court challenging an arbitrary ECL travel ban without notice for petitioner Ali Khan against Ministry of Interior.

test_cases.description: Draft a commercial lease agreement under Pakistani Contract Act.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a commercial lease agreement between landlord Malik Ahmed and tenant Bilal Khan for commercial shop 4B in Lahore.

test_cases.description: Fetch full text and headnotes of a reported judgment.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get the full judgment details for case citation 2023 SCMR 115.

negative_test_cases.description: Prevent legal research with an empty prompt query.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Request legal research with an empty query string.

negative_test_cases.description: Validate error handling when petition drafting is missing required fields.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Try to draft a petition without providing court name, petitioner name, or facts.

negative_test_cases.description: Handle lookup for non-existent judgment UUID or invalid ID gracefully.
